name: Segundo Cérebro
tagline: An Obsidian second brain with a morning brief and a nightly check-in
description: Opens a daily note for you, walks through the day's tasks first thing, and takes a spoken check-in at night. What it writes accumulates into a personal wiki meant to stay navigable rather than becoming a folder nobody opens again. It works in Portuguese.

source.excerpt: Shared as a Portuguese-language second-brain assistant built on Obsidian.

body:
## What it does

Opens a daily note for you, walks through the day's tasks first thing, and takes a spoken check-in at night. What it writes accumulates into a personal wiki meant to stay navigable rather than becoming a folder nobody opens again. It works in Portuguese. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @liderzio shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
